svg.text: Spring Boot, end to end — a concept map in restaurant terms
Each box gives the technical name, then the same idea as a person, a room, or a piece of paper in one restaurant. Read the bands top to bottom; follow the arrows to see what depends on what.
1 · THE FRANCHISE TRUCK · bootstrap and auto-configuration
2 · HIRING THE STAFF · the IoC container
2 · THE BRANCH SETTINGS SHEET · externalised configuration
3 · THE MANAGER IN FRONT OF THE CHEF · proxies and AOP · every box on the lower row only works on calls that actually go through the manager
4 · SERVING ONE CUSTOMER · the request pipeline
5 · THE BILL AND THE STOREROOM · transactions and persistence
6 · WHEN THE SUPPLIER STOPS ANSWERING · resilience and distributed work
7 · THE GAUGES BY THE DOOR · observability
8 · HOW YOU LAY THE PLACE OUT · architecture and the domain
R · REHEARSALS · the testing pyramid, sized to the band it points at
